name: Profound
tagline: Enterprise AI visibility platform that tracks brand mentions, citations and sentiment across up to 10 answer engines and adds AI marketing agents.
bestFor: Large brands that want AI visibility tracking, crawler analytics and marketing agents under one enterprise contract
description: Profound runs structured prompts across answer engines such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and Google AI Overviews and reports where a brand appears, which sources are cited, sentiment, ranking and competitive presence. Since September 2026 it sells only a custom-priced Enterprise plan for brands; the $399 Starter and $499 Growth plans are no longer available to new subscribers. The plan also includes AI Marketer agents, Agent Analytics for AI crawler traffic, Prompt Volumes data, CSV/JSON exports and an API.
pros: Tracks up to 10 answer engines: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Mode, Gemini, DeepSeek, Claude, Google AI Overviews, Exa Search, Muse Spark and Qwen
Daily prompt tracking with all-time history, CSV and JSON exports, and an API
Unlimited seats and unlimited domains in Agent Analytics
SSO/SAML and SOC 2 Type II compliance
Dedicated Slack channel and a dedicated specialist with a 24-hour SLA
cons: No published price: the only plan for brands is a custom Enterprise package that starts with a demo
Starter ($399) and Growth ($499) were retired in September 2026, so there is no self-serve entry tier
No free plan or free trial is listed on the pricing page
Prompt volume, languages, regions and AI Marketer credits are all set per contract, so limits are not public
Agents run on credits; going past the allotment means overage billing or paused usage
freePlanDetails: No free plan or trial is listed. Pricing is available only after requesting a demo.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Tailored package: custom prompt tracking plan with daily frequency, up to 10 answer engines, custom languages and regions, custom AI Marketer credits, unlimited seats, API, SSO. The former Starter ($399) and Growth ($499) plans were retired in September 2026 for new subscriptions.

integrations: Agent Analytics data sources: Akamai, AWS, Cloudflare, Fastly, Google Analytics, Google Cloud Platform, Netlify, Vercel and WordPress; MCP; API; CSV and JSON exports

name: Peec AI
tagline: AI search analytics that tracks prompts daily across three chosen AI models and shows visibility, sentiment, sources and recommended actions.
bestFor: SEO and content teams that want daily AI visibility data with unlimited users at a mid-range price
description: Peec AI tracks a set of prompts daily in AI models such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews and AI Mode and reports visibility, position, sentiment and share of voice against competitors. Source analytics show the domains and URLs AI answers cite, and a gap analysis and recommended actions point to sources where competitors appear but the brand does not. Paid plans run $95 to $495 per month with 3 models each; Enterprise unlocks up to 26 models, including Claude.
pros: Unlimited users, competitors and languages on every plan
Starter at $95/month already includes source analytics, citation share, sentiment and recommended actions
API from Pro ($245/month) and MCP on every plan
Holds a SOC 2 Type II report
Enterprise tracks up to 26 LLM models, including Claude, DeepSeek, Grok and Mistral
cons: Starter, Pro and Advanced track only 3 models; each extra model costs $30, $70 or $140 per month
Claude, DeepSeek, Grok and Mistral are only available on Enterprise
No API on Starter, and the Looker Studio connector starts at Advanced ($495/month)
Starter is limited to 50 prompts, 1 project and 1 country
Annual prices are not shown; the FAQ only says annual billing is 15% off

plans.name: Starter

plans.name: Advanced

name: Otterly.AI

name: LLMrefs
tagline: Keyword-based AI search tracker that turns SEO keywords into fan-out prompts and reports share of voice and citations across 11 AI engines.
bestFor: SEOs and agencies that want low-cost, keyword-based AI visibility tracking across many projects
description: LLMrefs tracks keywords rather than individual prompts: it generates fan-out prompts for each keyword and aggregates brand share of voice, position and cited source URLs across engines such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, AI Mode, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Grok, Copilot and Meta AI. Dashboard data is updated at least once per week.
